title: jspackr configuration
description: Configuration options supported by jspackr.config.json. The current loader silently ignores unrecognized properties; only the listed properties have an effect.

input.description: Entry JavaScript, JSX, TypeScript, or TSX file to bundle.

minify.description: Enable esbuild whitespace, syntax, and identifier minification.

report.description: Print bundle size and module information.

sourcemap.description: Source map mode: none disables maps, l creates a linked map, and in embeds an inline map.

watch.description: Rebuild when files under the entry file's directory change.

typeCheck.description: Run the project's locally installed TypeScript compiler with --noEmit before building. Requires TypeScript in node_modules; in watch mode it runs before each build.

force.description: Skip confirmation before overwriting an existing output file.

noConfirm.description: Skip all confirmation prompts, including creating a missing output directory.
